title_he: גֹּאֵל הָאָדָם קוֹרֵא לְךָ, אֱמֹר: הִנְנִי

lines: גֹּאֵל הָאָדָם קוֹרֵא לְךָ, אֱמֹר: הִנְנִי
אוֹי לְךָ מֵעֹנֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִסָּבֵל
כָּבוֹד לוֹ, נִשָּׂא הוּא, אֲדֹנָי סוֹלֵחַ

review: The hymn is the gospel summons: 1:1–4 is Isa 55:6 with John 8:12 and Ps 144:4, 2:1–4 is Heb 2:3 with Luke 12:20 and Isa 53:6, and 3:1–4 is Ps 130:7 with Isa 55:7 and Luke 15:7.
1:1 keeps the answer spoken inside the line (אֱמֹר: הִנְנִי), following the print's قُلْ: «هَا أَنَا», with the colon-convention before the quoted words.

1:3–4 keep the print's pair of images (life passing like a shadow; the reader walking blind), using צֵל with עָבַר as in Ps 144:4 and תּוֹעִיָּה as in Isa 32:10, so both halves are the psalm's own vocabulary.
